defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: V3/V10/V12/V13/V15 — validateVoiceBible returned precise codes (VOICE_LANGUAGE_UNSUPPORTED, NARRATOR_PERSONA_INVALID, CHARACTER_VOICE_CONFLICT, PRONUNCIATION_PROFILE_INVALID) but persistVersion collapsed them all into a generic VOICE_BIBLE_SCHEMA_INVALID.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: persistVersion hardcoded the error code instead of propagating errors[0].code.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: propagate the specific code; added tests asserting each structured code is reachable

defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: measureBaseline wrote artifacts.voiceBibleVersion with a hardcoded status:'VERIFIED'.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: The perf probe duplicated manifest-ref construction instead of reusing it, so it would have silently upgraded this project's honest UNRESOLVED reference to a false VERIFIED.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: extracted manifestReferenceFor() as the single construction site; the perf probe now measures the exact entry attachManifestReference would write
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.pinnedBy: V16 (asserts the probe performs no manifest write and cannot flip UNRESOLVED→VERIFIED)

defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: validateVoiceBible reported the persona/language symptom before the provider/language root cause.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: check ordering — persona checks ran before identity resolution.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: identity resolution now runs first so an unsupported language is never masked by the persona mismatch it causes

defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: character voice resolution inherited the bible locale, so a character speaking another language was wrongly refused with VOICE_LOCALE_UNSUPPORTED.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: locale is a delivery-level property, not a per-speaker one.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: locale now constrains the narrator only

defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: registerDagNode left the VOICE_BIBLE node at state=NOT_CREATED_YET with lockTarget=null and producedBy=null whenever bootstrapDag had already created the node as a future pipeline class — even though a real Voice Bible existed and versionRef had been updated.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: registerDagNode only handled the 'node absent' and 'versionRef changed' cases; it never completed a pre-existing placeholder node. Effect: the DAG misreported a real artifact as never-built AND the node had no lockTarget, so lock-aware invalidation silently opted the Voice Bible out of 1H.2 locking.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: registerDagNode now completes a pre-existing node via the canonical setters (setNodeVersion / setNodeState / setNodeLockTarget), and inspectDagEvidence now probes voice/voice-bible/*.json from disk exactly like the shot plan, so bootstrap yields a real CLEAN node from evidence instead of a placeholder
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.pinnedBy: V17 (asserts state/producedBy/provenance/lockTarget, plus a re-bootstrap-from-disk case)

defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: adding VOICE_BIBLE to the DAG lockTarget whitelist failed schema validation: /nodes/VOICE_BIBLE/lockTarget/targetType must be equal to one of the allowed values.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: schemas/recovery-state.schema.json carries a SECOND, independent lockTarget.targetType enum that was not updated alongside the artifactType enum and the TARGET_TYPES code list.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.impact: discovered only because F6 made the node actually attach a lockTarget; the broken enum was masked while the node stayed a placeholder
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: added VOICE_BIBLE to the recovery-state lockTarget enum
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.pinnedBy: V17 (the assertions fail closed against the schema)

defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.found: the golden-doc secret scanner rejected the metric key 'secretSafety' (matches /secret/i).
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.rootCause: metric name collided with a security control's own vocabulary.
defectsFoundAndFixedDuring21.fix: renamed the metric to credentialSafety rather than adding a scanner exception — a security control is never weakened for a naming convenience
